name: FluxBar
description:
Live upload and download speed in your top bar, with 30 days of local usage history.

• Separate download/upload or total speed, in bytes or bits
• Standard (↓ 120 KB/s ↑ 35 KB/s) or compact (120K / 35K, 120↓ 35↑) formats
• Steady-width label, so the top bar doesn't shift as speeds change
• Hover for download, upload and total details; click for today's and 30-day usage
• Network source: Automatic, Wi-Fi, Ethernet or all real interfaces (Docker, VMs and loopback are ignored; mobile broadband is included)
• Hide when idle, with an adjustable idle threshold
• Refresh every 1, 2, 3 or 5 seconds
• Left, center or right placement, custom text color and bold text
• Daily usage history with totals

Everything stays on your machine: no telemetry and no network requests.
